# Employment Agreement

This Employment Agreement is entered into between [Company] and [Employee]
on the Effective Date set forth in the signature block.

**1. Position and Duties**

Employee will serve as [Title], reporting to [Manager]. Employee agrees
to devote substantially all business time to the Company's business and
to comply with the Company's policies as in effect from time to time.

**2. Compensation**

Employee's base salary will be $[amount] per year, paid in accordance
with the Company's standard payroll practices. Employee is eligible for
the Company's standard benefits and any bonus or equity grants approved
by the Board.

**3. At-Will Employment**

Employment is at-will. Either party may terminate the employment
relationship at any time, with or without cause, with or without notice.

**4. Confidentiality**

Employee acknowledges that during employment, Employee will have access
to Confidential Information. Employee will hold all such information in
strict confidence and will not disclose it to any third party except as
necessary for Employee's duties.

**5. IP Assignment**

Employee assigns to the Company all right, title, and interest in any
Inventions made or conceived during employment that (a) relate to the
Company's business or (b) result from work performed for the Company.

**6. Non-Solicitation**

For twelve (12) months following termination, Employee will not solicit
the Company's employees or customers, subject to applicable law.

**7. Governing Law**

This Agreement is governed by the laws of [Jurisdiction].
